fieldValues.title: Creative work needs independent organising axes
fieldValues.summary: Party Utility needs a stable venue map alongside projects, tasks, people, line-up, sing-alongs and media; the current picture package combines spaces and work strands in one area type.
evidence: party-utility-comparison/package/spec.mjs defines area-kind as space or strand and makes area the common target for project records.
The organiser specified six venue spaces and separate project, task, person, line-up, sing-along and media lists on 2026-11-27.
The first session-notes run completed seven stages and remains at tasks; the second session has not yet been processed.
fieldValues.body: The desired dataset must retain place and project as separate dimensions: a project may span places and a place may host several projects. Programme requirements are supplied by the organiser, not findings extracted from the transcripts. Model-independent execution remains to be tested end to end; the existing runner documents a manual brief/apply path and an external command interface.
